name: pet-oh
title: Ohio pet insurance rating
summary: Rate pet health insurance in Ohio from one insurer's two filed programs: breeds, age, area and plan factors, discounts and fees, full premiums, ways of paying, policy terms and the errors in the filings.
description: Each task gives the AI the filed rate manuals of one insurer's two pet insurance programs in Ohio and the policy form of one of them, and states the facts in the question, such as a dog's breed, its age and the ZIP code. It asks for exact values: a premium, a factor, a breed group, a discount, a policy term, or the errors in the documents themselves. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Full premium
families.what: The whole rating sequence, with base rate, breed, age, area and plan factors, discounts and fees, up to the final premium.

families.name: Breed classification
families.what: The right species, breed group or life expectancy group for a named breed, a mix, or a mixed breed by weight.

families.name: Age factor
families.what: Age factors at enrollment and at renewal, and the age bands used in rating.

families.name: Area factor
families.what: State, ZIP and area factors, read from tables that are not in order.

families.name: Plan factor
families.what: Deductible, coinsurance, limit and copay factors, interpolated where the manual says to.

families.name: Discounts and fees
families.what: Which discounts a new policy can have, how they stack and cap, and where fees and optional benefits come in.

families.name: Ways of paying
families.what: Installment payments and the first year's cost for each way of paying.

families.name: Policy terms
families.what: Waiting periods, pre-existing conditions, exclusions, cancellation, refunds and cost shares, as the policy form states them.

families.name: The two programs side by side
families.what: The same dog or cat rated in both programs, each under its own rules.

families.name: Checking the documents
families.what: The filings' own errors, told apart from passages that only look wrong.
